title: Chemistry before local support loss in energetic perovskites
problem_background: In DAP-2, PAP-2, and PAP-H2 the potassium and perchlorate sublattices are fixed and only the A-site cation changes. Atom-identified records can show whether persistent A-site chemistry precedes loss of neighboring local [K(ClO4)6] support, and which exact first-exit classes account for the initial A-site population. Local support loss is not bulk framework collapse, and a net N-H loss operation does not identify the hydrogen acceptor.

environment.stack_hint: Python standard library for atom-identified event records

approach: For DAP-2, PAP-2 and PAP-H2, analyze three seeds per material at 1666 K using the bundled atom-identified first-exit, A-to-K neighborhood and K-site persistent-loss records. Verify the A-site heavy-atom join and each fixed eight-K neighborhood. Define t_chem from the recorded 500 fs persistent chemical first-exit onset and t_support as the median 500 fs persistent [K(ClO4)6] loss onset among its eight neighbors. Preserve right-censoring. Aggregate ordering and exact-operation branch shares by seed before material; neighboring A sites are not independent replicas.

reproduction_target.summary: Recompute whether persistent A-site chemistry precedes neighboring local [K(ClO4)6] support loss, and whether exact single N-H loss is the largest persistent first-exit class in each material.
reproduction_target.scope: Analysis-level reproduction from genuine, bundled 1666 K event observations for three A-site variants. Report pooled, material, and seed ordering fractions, with equal times counted separately from the strict inequality, and seed-mean branch shares for the exact single-operation classes. Do not copy a published percentage. The result is a local timing and branch comparison. It does not rerun trajectories, assign the hydrogen acceptor, or support Arrhenius, CShM, or experimental thermal claims.

assets.name: Atom-identified 1666 K event observations
assets.description: Three compact CSVs at https://github.com/SchrodingersCattt/pap-h2-research-arm/tree/main/task/data: exits.csv records atom-identified persistent first exits and their operations, neighborhoods.csv maps each A site to eight K units, and k_sites.csv records independently computed [K(ClO4)6] persistent loss onsets. Download these real source records to reproduce the event-level analysis.

workflow.title: Validate atom-identified source events
workflow.action: Check the one-to-one A-site heavy-atom join, nine complete 192-site seeds, eight distinct neighbors per site, and explicit 500 fs support-loss onset and censoring fields. Chemical onsets use the 10 fs grid and support onsets use the 100 fs grid.

workflow.title: Join chemical and local-support events
workflow.action: Join each recorded chemical first exit to the median 500 fs [K(ClO4)6] loss onset among its eight fixed neighboring K units. Retain each site, its exact operation, and its support censoring.

workflow.title: Summarize ordering and first-exit branches
workflow.action: From the per-site records, recompute pooled, material, and seed fractions with t_chem < t_support, count equal times separately, and report seed-mean branch shares for exact single N-H loss, the material-specific C-H classes, C-N opening, and the remaining compound exits. State only the qualitative pattern those records support.

outputs.description: One row per initial A site with atom-linked first-exit and neighborhood support-loss timing, explicit censoring, and exact operation identity.
Ordering fractions and exact-operation branch shares recomputed from site_events.csv, plus an interpretation limited to local [K(ClO4)6] support.

scoring.summary: Recompute coverage, ordering fractions, equality counts, and branch shares from the site records. Accept the interpretation only when it follows those recomputed records and stays inside local-support scope.

constraints: Retain all initial A sites, censoring, the 500 fs chemical and geometric persistence criteria, seed identity, and the 10 fs versus 100 fs sampling distinction. Use a denominator of 192 initial A sites per seed for branch shares. Do not infer the hydrogen acceptor from net N-H loss. Do not call local [K(ClO4)6] loss bulk framework collapse.
